app.name: PureInvoicing
app.description: Outgoing invoices: prepare them, issue them as numbered PDFs, and keep track of what was sent and paid.

tools.name: fn_receivablesBriefing
tools.description: Compile a one-shot accounts receivable and billing briefing across the workspace. Replaces calling getWorkspaceState plus multiple searchInvoices, listAgreements, and listProposals calls. Returns setup readiness, next invoice label, YTD and all-time totals by currency, overdue and open invoices prioritized by days overdue, unissued drafts and corrections, unbilled agreement milestones or retainer months, and open proposals.

limit.description: Maximum rows per section (overdue, open, drafts, pipeline). Default 10.

includeDrafts.description: Include unissued drafts and correction drafts (default true).

includePipeline.description: Include ready-to-bill agreement milestones, unbilled retainer months, and open proposals (default true).

tools.name: fn_clientBillingDossier
tools.description: Compile a complete billing dossier for one client in a single call. Replaces calling searchClients, searchInvoices, listAgreements, listProposals, listLibrary, and readLibraryDocument. Returns client profile and billing defaults, lifetime and YTD totals, average days to pay, overdue/open/draft/recent paid invoices, active agreements with unbilled milestones, proposals, and any client-specific invoicing rules from the library.

query.description: Client name, contact name, or email fragment when clientId is not known.

invoiceLimit.description: Maximum recent paid invoices to return (default 15).

includeRuleExcerpts.description: Include text excerpts of client invoice-rules library documents (default true).

tools.name: fn_agingAndCashflowReport
tools.description: Analyze accounts receivable aging buckets and recent cash collection across all issued invoices by currency. Replaces calling getWorkspaceState and paging through searchInvoices and getInvoice. Groups unpaid balances into current, 1-30, 31-60, 61-90, and 90+ days overdue buckets using exact currency rounding, computes collection velocity and recent paid totals, and ranks top overdue debtors.

asOfDate.description: ISO date (YYYY-MM-DD) for aging calculations. Defaults to local today.

currency.description: Optional ISO 4217 currency filter (e.g. USD, EUR).

paidWindowDays.description: Lookback window in days for recent cash collections (default 90).

tools.name: fn_buildClientInvoiceDraft
tools.description: Prepare a complete, saved invoice draft for a client in one transaction. Replaces searchClients, createInvoiceDraft, applyDefaultsToDraft, and updateInvoiceDraft (or cloning a prior invoice). Resolves the client, applies business and client billing defaults, sets line items, dates, terms, reference, currency, and notes, and returns authoritative recalculated totals, validation diagnostics, and any client invoicing rules from the library. Never issues or assigns a permanent invoice number.

clientId.description: Exact client ID to apply billing details, currency, and terms from.

clientQuery.description: Client name or email to look up when clientId is omitted.

sourceInvoiceId.description: Optional prior invoice or draft ID to copy structure and lines from before applying overrides.

invoiceDate.description: Optional ISO invoice date (defaults to local today).

dueDate.description: Optional explicit ISO due date (sets termsDays to custom/null unless termsDays is also passed).

termsDays.description: Optional payment terms in days from invoiceDate.

reference.description: Optional PO number or invoice reference.

notes.description: Optional notes printed on the invoice.

lineItems.description: Ordered line items to place on the draft.

tools.name: fn_auditInvoiceReadiness
tools.description: Audit one invoice draft or correction for issuance readiness, business setup completeness, client invoicing rule compliance, and potential duplicate billing. Replaces calling getWorkspaceState, getInvoice, listLibrary, and searchInvoices separately. Reports missing required fields, currency review flags, sequence verification status, matching client library rules, and recent invoices for the same recipient with identical amounts or references without modifying any data.

draftId.description: ID of the saved invoice draft or correction draft to audit.

tools.name: fn_reconcilePaymentsAudit
tools.description: Reconcile and audit payment status across issued invoices and contractor bills in one pass. Replaces calling searchInvoices, getInvoice, and getAgreement repeatedly. Identifies issued invoices not yet marked sent, sent invoices past due without a paid mark, paid invoices missing payment references, and unpaid or over-cap contractor bills, optionally matching supplied incoming payment amounts or references to open invoices.

payments.description: Optional incoming payment items to match against open invoices (read-only suggestions).

includeContractorBills.description: Also audit unpaid and warning-flagged contractor bills (default true).

tools.name: fn_agreementsBillingSummary
tools.description: Summarize all client and contractor agreements, billing progress, ready-to-invoice milestones, unbilled retainer months, draft readiness blockers, and contractor bill checks in a single call. Replaces calling listAgreements followed by repeated getAgreement and searchContractors calls. Filters optionally by status, direction, clientId, or contractorId.

tools.name: fn_proposalsPipelineOverview
tools.description: Summarize the proposals and quotes pipeline across draft, offered, accepted, and declined stages in a single call. Replaces calling listProposals and getProposal for each proposal. Returns stage counts and totals by currency, accepted proposals awaiting conversion to an invoice draft, open offered proposals awaiting customer decision, and incomplete drafts with their blocking fields.

tools.name: getWorkspaceState
tools.description: Read first-use and setup status, the business identity and default terms, default template, the number pattern (e.g. INV-{YYYY}-{NNN}) with the next counter and the label it will produce, archive counts, this year's invoiced/collected/outstanding totals by currency, per-client history, supported currencies and presentation options, and metadata for user-uploaded logo and PDF assets. Does not export attachment contents.

tools.name: searchInvoices
tools.description: Search the archive by number, client or reference and filter by status: draft, issued (all finalized), open (issued and not marked paid), sent, overdue (past due and not paid), paid. Returns IDs, numbers and their labels (numberText), recipient, dates, totals, standing marks, days overdue, historical labels, correction availability, latest version, and pagination. Does not alter the user's saved work or navigation state.

tools.name: getInvoice
tools.description: Read an invoice's saved details, content and appearance snapshots, calculated totals, save status, PDF availability and provenance, source link, and chronological version and reissue history. An issued invoice defaults to its current issued version and separately identifies any correction draft. A selected older version is explicitly marked superseded.

versionId.description: Optional retained issued version to inspect.

includeCorrection.description: Include the saved unpublished correction content, if present.

tools.name: searchClients
tools.description: Read or search reusable client records, returning IDs, names, billing addresses, contact details, and tax identifiers with pagination.

tools.name: saveClient
tools.description: Explicitly create a reusable client or update supplied fields of an existing client. Does not change recipient snapshots in any invoice. A new client requires a nonempty name.

termsDays.description: Usual payment terms for this client, in days.

currency.description: Usual invoicing currency, an ISO 4217 code.

tools.name: createInvoiceDraft
tools.description: Create and save a blank draft using current business and template defaults, or a separate draft copied from a prior invoice. Copying uses its current issued version unless a retained source version is specified, links the source, copies editable content and appearance, resets invoice date to local today, clears due date and reference, and never copies its number. Returns a summary: the draft id and revision, provisional label, recipient, dates, currency, line count, totals and diagnostics (not the content; call getInvoice for the lines).

tools.name: updateInvoiceDraft
tools.description: Save supplied content fields of an ordinary draft or unpublished correction without modifying issued versions. Omitted fields are preserved; empty strings or null dates clear values. A supplied lineItems array replaces the complete ordered list. Incomplete work is permitted. Replies with a summary: revision, saved state, line count, authoritative recalculated totals, field diagnostics, and a price-review warning if currency changes (not the content; call getInvoice for the lines). Currency changes never convert prices.

termsDays.description: Payment terms in days after the invoice date; the due date follows while set. Null means a custom due date.

tools.name: prepareInvoiceFinalization
tools.description: Validate saved invoice content and all preview pages and prepare a read-only confirmation for ordinary issue-and-export, same-number correction-and-export, or historical registration. Returns blocking errors or an expiring confirmation token bound to the draft revision, settings, proposed number, totals, action, and supplied registration details or change note. Includes recipient, dates, currency, totals, a preview summary (page count, page problems, whether the PDF is retained; call getInvoicePreview for page images and text), correction differences, historical labels, and sequence impact. Does not assign or reserve a number, publish changes, or export files.

originalPdfAssetId.description: Optional uploaded original PDF, retained as an unverified historical reference.

tools.name: finalizeInvoice
tools.description: Commit exactly the approved confirmation from prepareInvoiceFinalization. Atomically rechecks revision, validation, and number uniqueness; rejects stale confirmations rather than changing approved details. Ordinary issuance permanently assigns the next number and retains a version; a correction retains prior versions and publishes under the same number; historical registration retains the entered original-number record and labeled optional reference PDF, advancing the sequence if necessary. Issue and correction actions also prepare and offer the matching PDF with an invoice-number and client filename. Returns publication and PDF outcomes separately, including invoice/version IDs for safe PDF retry. Repeated use of a successfully committed token returns that same result and never creates another issuance.

tools.name: exportInvoicePdf
tools.description: Offer an existing invoice PDF for download, generating or retrying the app-produced PDF for the selected immutable issued version if needed. Does not issue an invoice, change content, allocate a number, or create a version. Ordinary download may select an older superseded version or the labeled original historical reference. Reissue always offers the current app-produced issued PDF unchanged and records a brief reissue event without claiming delivery. Returns availability, recognizable filename, version/provenance labels, and any export failure.

versionId.description: Omit for the current issued version.

tools.name: markInvoice
tools.description: Set or clear a sent or paid mark on an issued invoice. Marks are the user's record, never inferred: sent takes an optional ISO date and recipient, paid an optional ISO date (the day the money arrived, never in the future), payment reference and note; marking paid again edits the payment record, clear removes one mark. Overdue is computed from the due date and cannot be set. Issued content, numbers and versions never change. Read the invoice first with getInvoice.

note.description: Free note about the payment, e.g. part-paid or paid by a parent company.

tools.name: listAgreements
tools.description: List agreements (MSAs, SOWs, change orders, NDAs, contractor agreements) with their party, status, value and what has been invoiced against client agreements, plus the totals. Status 'signed' means active. Call this first to find ids.

tools.name: getAgreement
tools.description: Read one agreement in full: sections (with ids), fee, milestones, checks that block sending, invoices billed against it, unbilled retainer months, contractor bills with their check, parent and child agreements.

tools.name: listProposals
tools.description: Proposals (enquiries and the offers made for them), newest first: id, title, customer, standing (draft, offered, accepted, declined), version count, the version shown with its total and currency, and the invoice made from it if any. Filter by status or clientId, or search title and customer. Proposals are not invoices and use no invoice numbers.

query.description: Words in the title or customer name.

tools.name: discoverAppTools
tools.description: Discover PureInvoicing's extended specialist tools (57 tools across agreements, contractors, documents, invoices, library, presentation, proposals, templates, workspace) and composite functions (8 workflows). Prefer calling exposed composite functions and core tools first; use discoverAppTools when an edge case needs a specialist tool, then call it via callExtendedReadTool (for read-only tools) or callExtendedTool (for mutating tools).

query.description: Optional keywords describing the capability you need (e.g. "agreements", "contractors", "documents", "invoices", "library").

category.description: Optional category filter (agreements, contractors, documents, invoices, library, presentation, proposals, templates, workspace, or "all").

names.description: Optional exact tool names to fetch full JSON input schemas for.

includeFunctions.description: Include already-exposed composite functions and core tools in the listing (default false: searches extended tools first).

tools.name: callExtendedReadTool
tools.description: Call one of PureInvoicing's read-only extended specialist tools discovered via discoverAppTools (categories: agreements, contractors, documents, invoices, library, presentation, proposals, templates, workspace). Strictly refuses mutating, destructive, external, or release tools.

tool.description: Exact name of a read-only extended tool from discoverAppTools.

arguments.description: Arguments object matching the tool’s inputSchema.

tools.name: callExtendedTool
tools.description: Call one of PureInvoicing's mutating extended specialist tools discovered via discoverAppTools (categories: agreements, contractors, documents, invoices, library, presentation, proposals, templates, workspace). For destructive tools, set confirmDestructive: true after checking with the user. Strictly refuses read-only tools (use callExtendedReadTool), external tools, permanent-delete tools, and release tools.

tool.description: Exact name of a mutating extended tool from discoverAppTools.

arguments.description: Arguments object matching the tool’s inputSchema.

confirmDestructive.description: Required (true) when calling an extended tool marked risk: "destructive".
